page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a standard general-purpose resource. It offers a balanced density of compute and memory resources without the premium cost associated with specialized GPU or high-capacity local storage hardware. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as medium-scale web serving, enterprise applications, containerized microservices, and general-purpose application hosting that rely on network-attached storage.
